label.zh: 异常调查后约30%概率得到线索
label.en: About 30% of anomaly follow-ups yield a clue

bridges.evidence: common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3291 pop_lcluster_event (random 7 nothing / 3 → country_event distar.9000 days 10) is called by many anomaly outcomes; it needs has_distar, encountered_first_lgate and a chain whose 7 clues are not complete (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1140).

common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3243 generate_lcluster_clue: each clue adds to the l_cluster_chain counter 'clues' (max 7, common/event_chains/00_event_chains_distant_stars.txt:27) and when it is complete fires distar.10904 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1280). Clues also come from the repeatable tech tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue (distar.12000) and many anomaly/event options.

label.zh: 研究“星门激活”科技且拥有L-星门
label.en: Research the L-Gate activation tech while owning an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2698 on_tech_increased → distar.10903 (hidden: last_increased_tech = tech_lgate_activation, l_cluster not opened) → distar.10900 (hidden): owns_lgate_megastructure → enable_lgate_project_on_owned_gateway → distar.10905 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1196-1213, common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3468).

label.zh: 研究该科技但没有L-星门
label.en: Research the tech without owning an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1207-1212 distar.10900 else → distar.10901 "L-Gate Needed"; option a re-checks every 60 days through hidden distar.10902 until a gate is owned, option b liquidates the clues for resources.

label.zh: 邻国已收集超过5条线索并拥有L-星门
label.en: A neighbour has more than 5 clues and owns an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:107 on_monthly_pulse → distar.10955 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1498-1566): a human player with the chain or project has communications with a country with chain, num_lcluster_clues > 5 and an lgate_base; that player then gets distar.10956 once per warned country.

label.zh: 科学船抵达幼龙所在恒星
label.en: A science ship reaches the star where a young L-Drake waits

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1026 on_entering_system_fleet → distar.13030 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2082): a science ship enters a dragon_point system holding a baby nanite space dragon the owner has not visited; option a (not homicidal, not fanatic xenophobe) starts TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT.

common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1463 on_ship_destroyed_perp → distar.13020 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2009): the destroyed ship belongs to a country of type ldragon_country; the reward is larger if the L-Drake was already known (ldragon_known).

label.zh: 项目完成，且其他结局条件均未满足
label.en: Project complete, if no other ending applies

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1380 distar.10950 (hidden, fired by LCLUSTER_PROJECT on_success, common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:667) else-branch fires distar.10951 and distar.10960

label.zh: 项目完成：龙之季，无L-星门星系的国家收到通知
label.en: Project complete: dragon season; countries without an L-Gate system get this notice

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1373 else_if dragon_season -> hidden distar.13000 (L1811-1862) -> distar.13011 for every playable country with no lgate system within borders

label.zh: 项目完成：龙之季，拥有L-星门星系的国家见到幼龙
label.en: Project complete: dragon season; owners of L-Gate systems see the young drake

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1373 else_if dragon_season -> hidden distar.13000 spawns young dragons at dragon_point systems and fires distar.13010 at the owner of each gate system (L1899-1902)

label.zh: 项目完成：灰色风暴危机（另一故事）
label.en: Project complete: the Gray Tempest crisis (another story)

label.zh: 项目完成：灰雾帝国（另一故事）
label.en: Project complete: the gray goo empire (another story)

label.zh: 另一国家开启星团：正在进行此项目的国家收到中止通知
label.en: Another country opens the cluster: countries running this project are told it is aborted

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1394-1402 distar.10950 every_playable_country with LCLUSTER_PROJECT (not the opener) -> distar.10952 after 1 day

label.zh: 另一国家开启星团：有事件链但无项目的国家收到通知
label.en: Another country opens the cluster: countries with the chain but no project are told

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1414-1422 distar.10950 every_playable_country with l_cluster_chain, no project -> distar.10953 after 1 day

label.zh: 另一国家开启星团：无事件链的国家收到通知
label.en: Another country opens the cluster: countries without the chain are told

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1404-1412 distar.10950 every_playable_country with no chain and no project -> distar.10954 after 1 day

label.zh: 开启后的结局（开局已决定）
label.en: Outcome after opening (decided at game start)

note.zh: 开局事件 distar.8000 在启用L-星门时随机：50（若禁用破坏性玩法则为0）灰色风暴危机、30无事、30龙之季、30灰雾帝国（events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1109-1129）；distar.10950 按全局标志选择 graygoo.1 / distar.13000 / graygoo.100 / distar.10951。　13010（拥有星门星系者）与13011（无星门星系者）是同一龙之季结局里按国家分的两份通知。
note.en: The game-start event distar.8000 rolls when L-Gates are enabled: 50 gray goo crisis (0 if disruptive gameplay is blocked), 30 nothing, 30 dragon season, 30 gray goo empire (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1109-1129); distar.10950 then picks graygoo.1 / distar.13000 / graygoo.100 / distar.10951 by the global flag.  Within dragon season, 13010 (owners of gate systems) and 13011 (countries without one) are per-country notices.

label.zh: 他国开启后，每个国家只收到其中一条通知
label.en: When another country opens the cluster, each country gets exactly one of these notices

note.zh: 按是否正在做本项目、是否有事件链划分（distant_stars_events_3.txt:1394-1422）。
note.en: Split by whether the country runs the project or has the chain (distant_stars_events_3.txt:1394-1422).

note.zh: 平静的结局：L-星团开放，其余L-星门将在之后数年内陆续启用。
note.en: A quiet ending: the cluster opens, and the other L-Gates activate one by one over the following years.

note.zh: 项目完成后，该恒星系归你所有。
note.en: After the project the system is yours.

scope.zh: 整条L-星团故事：入口、线索来源（逐一定位约33个调用事件并核对统一门槛）、线索满七、研究、项目、完成后的结局与他国通知、龙之季后续、邻国预警。
scope.en: Whole L-Cluster story: entry, clue sources (about 33 calling events located and the central gate checked), seven clues, research, project, outcomes and notices to other countries after opening, dragon-season follow-ups, neighbour warning.

uncertain: apoc.3 (surveyed L-Gate) starts the same chain in event-apoc-3; both entries are shown/described but only distar.13080 owns this story.
The clue-giving events (about 33) are listed in a note and the guide, not as nodes; their own gates belong to their stories.

notes.zh: 审阅说明（线索来源）：generate_lcluster_clue（00_scripted_effects.txt:3243-3262）和 pop_lcluster_event（:3291-3305）本身统一要求拥有《遥远繁星》、事件链 l_cluster_chain 且星团尚未开启，所以各调用点无需单独验证。调用它们的事件共约33个：artifact_actions.txt:80；anomaly.5/30/2531/3120/4020/6705、aianom.11；distar.40/46/70/220/225/231/265/270/275/280/285/312/313/315/1031/1040/2041/2046/5058/12000；leviathans.600；crisis.8060；over.60；pirate.15/26。这些属于各自的故事，此处不逐一列为节点。
notes.en: Review note (clue sources): generate_lcluster_clue (00_scripted_effects.txt:3243-3262) and pop_lcluster_event (:3291-3305) themselves require Distant Stars, the chain l_cluster_chain and an unopened cluster, so each call site needs no separate gate check. About 33 events call them: artifact_actions.txt:80; anomaly.5/30/2531/3120/4020/6705, aianom.11; distar.40/46/70/220/225/231/265/270/275/280/285/312/313/315/1031/1040/2041/2046/5058/12000; leviathans.600; crisis.8060; over.60; pirate.15/26. They belong to their own stories and are not listed here as nodes.
